title: Declined estimate resets nothing; freeform or canned work; completion decides
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A due service is visible on a work order, the worklist or the asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Add a service onto an estimate and decline it; confirm the service stays due and on the list.
  2. Confirm a shop writing PM-A as one 4-hour line and a shop writing it as four canned lines are both possible.
  3. On a work order whose lines were typed by hand, satisfy a due service without re-adding the lines.
  4. Approve a previously-declined estimate, complete it, and confirm the schedule advances.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A declined estimate resets nothing; the service stays due and stays on the list.
  • A shop that writes PM-A as one four-hour line and a shop that writes four canned lines must both be possible.
  • An existing work order whose lines were typed by hand can satisfy a due service without re-adding the lines.
  • A declined estimate later approved and completed advances the schedule - the completion decides, not the path taken to it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S17; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
